name: 911 SSPO Invoicing Prep
description: Feed it the whole SSPO pricing master and pick a close-out date range: rows whose Firm VPD falls in the range are split into one workbook per Batch + Nest ('BATCH NEST Pricing Back Up.xlsx', each in its own 'BATCH NEST Invoicing Docs' folder) with an Invoice Supplement tab (PO/Line, invoice number and ship date from the Working Forecast List) printed to PDF as 'ASA Invoice No. XXXXX Supplement.pdf' once the nest has its PS/Inv number, plus two top-level weekly reports - 'D911 Workorder Close Outs' (cols A-Machine, Scheduling Group set to Closed) and the full 'D911 Workorder Material Status' listing.
author: Anthony Sieben

setup: Make a copy of the SSPO pricing master (the whole thing - no need to trim it to the week) - you pick the file when the app opens.
Keep the Working Forecast List synced; the app pulls each nest's PO, PO Line, PS/Inv (invoice number) and Ship Date from it.
how_it_works: Pick the pricing workbook, then pick the close-out date range (it starts on the last 7 days; set both dates the same for a single day).
Rows whose Firm VPD falls in the range are the week's close-outs: the app splits them into one workbook per Batch + Nest.
Each split gets a Pricing Back Up tab (with a total-per-work-order sum) and an ASA Invoice Supplement tab.
It reads the PO / PO Line, PS/Inv and Ship Date from a temp copy of the forecast (never the live file) and links prices through, so a corrected price flows to the grand total.

A nest with a PS/Inv number gets its Invoice Supplement sheet printed to PDF (through Excel). A nest with none gets a blank Invoice # and no PDF, and the run summary names it - fill the forecast in and re-run, or print that one by hand.
The Material Status listing covers every row in the file, not just the range.
output: One 'BATCH NEST Pricing Back Up.xlsx' per nest in the range, each in its own 'BATCH NEST Invoicing Docs' subfolder.
'ASA Invoice No. XXXXX Supplement.pdf' in that same folder for every nest that has an invoice number - it sorts right behind the Mie Trak invoice in the finished-docs folder.
A top-level 'D911 Workorder Close Outs {date}.xlsx' (the range's rows, Scheduling Group set to Closed).
A top-level 'D911 Workorder Material Status {date}.xlsx' (the 14-column listing, every row).
Both reports are named for the range's end date. The output folder opens in Explorer when it's done.

fields.label: Sentry Drone mode
fields.description: Pick the file or folder through the targeting-drone kill-cam - crosshair cursor, lock-on, and a railgun strike on the target. Off = a normal Explorer dialog. Buy the Sentry Drone at Woogy's Emporium; set every app at once from My Stuff.
